name: Chisel
text: Adopt Luma’s built-in transcript tool for every pending video now. It’s the fastest way to lock in transcripts without API keys or quota fights, and it’s already tuned to Luma’s pipeline. The trade-off is accepting its 10-20% silent failure rate, but we catch gaps immediately in the workflow and fix them before they compound. Operations keeps moving; Creatives get transcripts today.

name: Sift
text: Luma’s built-in transcript tool still outsources reliability to an external service—if it fails, we’re stuck waiting for fixes we can’t control. The real fix is to run kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript now, but log failures explicitly and rerun them in batches. Engineering owns the script; Scriv verifies gaps within 24 hours.
